title: tc-integration-picker
description: The integrations page of a command menu: search, a grouped list and the picked service's details with a switch.

integrations.description: The services to list, grouped into Connected and Available – the sample services by default

appName.description: Your product's name in the details, e.g. "Trenchcoat + Linear"

selected.description: Id of the picked integration; unset picks the first

connected.description: Ids of the connected integrations; unset follows the integrations' `connected` flags

hotkey.description: Window shortcut that jumps into the search: "mod+/" by default, any other combination, or false for none

back.description: Shows the back button (and ← in an empty search goes back)

domain.description: Shown under the name in the details, e.g. "linear.app"

path.description: Brand mark: a single SVG path on a 24 × 24 grid in `color` – or pass your own `icon`

tile.description: Background of the logo tile – the brand color with a white mark, or white with a colored mark

connected.description: Starts connected. Read again whenever the flags change (when `connected` isn't set on the picker)
